text:
Absolutely — I can help with that. Since you cook for you and your partner, I’d keep it simple and Mediterranean-leaning, with no grams/calories or day-by-day tracking.

A good week could be built around:
- Proteins: eggs, Greek yogurt, chicken, tuna or salmon, chickpeas, lentils
- Vegetables: salad greens, tomatoes, cucumbers, peppers, zucchini, broccoli, onions
- Fruit: berries, apples, bananas, citrus
- Carbs: bread or pita, rice, pasta, potatoes, oats
- Fats and flavor: olive oil, feta, olives, hummus, nuts, garlic, lemons, herbs

If you want, I can turn this into a full grocery list or a simple week of meals next.

attributes.reason: It explicitly avoids grams/calories and day-by-day tracking.
It offers help, but doesn’t really do any check-in style reporting one way or the other.
It clearly frames the plan as Mediterranean-leaning and uses Mediterranean foods.
It directly addresses cooking for you and your partner, i.e. two people.
